title: fix(metadata-protocol): accept a first draft pinned with the published version a read served
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSVBUQ4afoDx499n7JLJrYha)_
Fixes #37628

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The published text this removes a refusal against, `save_metadata_draft`'s `ifMatch` description in `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts` on `main` @ `33a31dc7` (line 345):

> Optional: the `version` a read or a save answered. The save is refused if the draft changed since.

A read of a published item with no draft answers that item's `version`; the save refused it every time. Still the text on `main`, so the declaration stays `no`.

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：AI 通过轻门改一个已发布、还没有草稿的项时，带上读到的版本号第一次保存就能成功，不再必然被拒。
- 为什么做：云端 agent 效果专题（M1），实测 12 次改已发布项有 9 次白白撞上这次拒绝，模型只好去掉版本号，乐观锁也被绕开。
- 出错会怎样：只影响首次草稿保存的版本比较；读后已发布项被改过，或别人先存了草稿，依旧拒绝并给出当前版本号；可直接撤回本 PR。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **The comparison** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts`, the save door's parent resolution). With no draft row at the write address (`currentStored === null`, `mode: 'draft'`, a string token), the token is compared with the published head the draft would replace: the active row at the package the draft is written into (`writeHead.packageId`, the named package or the one a package-less draft inherits), same bundle member and body as the draft head read. On a match the draft is written with a `null` parent, so the repository's own lock still refuses a draft another caller wrote between this read and the put. On a mismatch the existing `InboundVersionConflictError` is thrown with the published head, so the 409 `METADATA_CONFLICT` names the current published version (`currentVersion`, "current is ...") and a retry with it is accepted. No published row either: head `null`, as before. Every other arm is unchanged: an existing draft is still compared with the draft head only, an unpinned save and the first-write pin (`null` parent) take their old paths, and publish mode is untouched.
- **Wording** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts`, card item 3). `get_metadata_item` now says a read with `state` answers that version's `version`, the token `save_metadata_draft` takes as `ifMatch`, and a read without `state` answers none (the `previewDrafts` read serves no `version`, pinned by the existing #22114 test). `ifMatch` now says the save is refused when the pending draft, or the published item while it has no draft, changed since, and that the refusal names the current version.
- One `patch` changeset for both packages.
- **REST pin** (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-version-token-occ.test.ts`, test-only). Its arm "after a publish (no draft row): a held `If-Match` is refused 409 with `currentVersion: null`" pinned the defect: the held token was the draft published unchanged, so it names the live row. Split into (a) that token writes the next draft, and (b) a held token the published row moved past is refused `METADATA_CONFLICT` / 409 naming the current published version, then `If-None-Match: *` writes the next draft. `packages/rest/**` was outside the order's file surface; the seat widened it to this one file, recorded on the card.

### PM mechanism assumptions, measured on `main` @ `33a31dc7`
- Falsified in part: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-conflict.ts` only BUILDS the 409 (`saveConflict`). The comparison is `storedParentForToken` (`protocol-lock-version-gates.ts:537`), and the draft-save call is `protocol-save.ts:2192`, which handed it the draft head (null on a first draft). The fix is at that call, inside the order's file surface.
- `mcp-authoring.ts` save path at `:811-836`: confirmed (the `ifMatch` → `parentVersion` hand-off at `:836`).
- Every caller of the comparison, and whether it gets the fix:
  - `protocol-save.ts` `saveMetaItemUnaudited` — **gets it.** It is the one save door: the MCP `save_metadata_draft` (`ifMatch`), the REST `/meta` draft save (`If-Match`, `packages/rest/src/meta-save-request.ts`) that Studio and REST clients use, and the runtime meta domain's dispatch all reach it through `saveMetaItem`. Studio's draft guard pins a first draft with `If-None-Match: *` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/draftVersionGuard.ts`, `draftPinOf`), the `null` arm this does not touch.
  - `protocol-history-and-publish.ts:984` (per-item publish of a draft, the `draftVersion` pin against the draft row) and `:1437` (publish's active-row pin) — not a draft save; they compare with the row they promote over, unchanged.
  - `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts:894` (delete) — unchanged.

## Tests

Pins in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.served-content-hash.test.ts` (the shared harness for the version token, new top-level `describe` per the shared-harness rule), each refusal asserting `code` and `status`:
- accepted the first time: read the published item (`state: 'active'`), save a draft with that `version`; the draft is written and the published row is untouched; the draft's own version then pins the next draft save;
- refused when the published row changed after the read: `METADATA_CONFLICT` / 409, `currentVersion` and "current is ..." name the new published version, no stored hash leaks, no draft written; a retry with `currentVersion` is accepted;
- refused when another caller saved a draft after the read (card acceptance 2): `METADATA_CONFLICT` / 409 naming that draft's version, their draft kept;
- a draft written between the head read and the put is refused by the repository's lock (`METADATA_CONFLICT` / 409), their draft kept.

Changed pin: the #22114 test "the conflict refusal states `currentVersion`" asserted that a draft save pinned with the CURRENT published version and no draft row was refused with `currentVersion: null`, i.e. the defect itself. It now pins a stale published version (refused, naming the current published version) and a token for an item with no row in either lifecycle (refused, `currentVersion: null`, the old sentence's meaning).

Ablation: with the fix reverted on disk (`git restore --source=origin/main -- packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts`) the file goes `4 failed | 29 passed (33)` (the changed #22114 pin, the acceptance, the moved-published retry and the race); restored, `33 passed (33)`. The "another caller's draft" refusal passes in both states, as the refusal half should.

Local runs (`claude/project-thread-vuyoa7`, worktree off `33a31dc7`, head `6f387613`):
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 370 passed, 9 skipped (379); Tests 23444 passed, 45 skipped (23489).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`: 57 passed (57).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/meta-item-version-token-occ.test.ts`: 16 passed (16) (before the split, on the fixed source: 1 failed, 14 passed, the defect pin); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 70 commands, re-run at head `6f387613`): 69 exit 0; 1 exit 3, NOT MEASURED (`node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: the shallow clone cannot reach its pinned positive-control commit; checker-health only, CI runs it). `--ran` reconciliation: 70 derived, 69 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Acceptance notes

- A draft saved into a package other than the one the item is published in has no published head at its address, so a token read from the other package's row is still refused (`current is null`). That is the row the draft replaces on publish, so the comparison is right there; noted, not changed.

## Verification

Read first: `protocol-save.ts` (the first-draft arm in the parent resolution), then the new `describe` in `protocol.served-content-hash.test.ts`.

Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.served-content-hash.test.ts` prints `33 passed (33)`.
